node.title: Re^3: Capture a non-printable char and test what it is
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Where do you find that?

[kcott] is right that I simply looked at the code's output, but it's also documented in [doc://perlop#Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators].

If I look at the ascii table I see that the escape key can be represented as: 27 (decimal), 1B (hexadecimal), 033 (octal).

Those work too: the string "\e" is the same as "\x1B" and "\033" - you can try this out yourself with eq.
